L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.

L16: Every command shall be a single 8-bit opcode latched on CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n rising.
L16: Every address byte shall be 8 bits latched on CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n rising.
L16: Read / Page Program shall have 5 address cycles (2 column + 3 row); Block Erase 3 row cycles.
L16: Read Status (70h) shall return {WP_n, RDY, ARDY, VSP, CSP, R, FAILC, FAIL}.
L16: Status bit 6 (RDY) shall be 0 during command in progress; SR[5:0] invalid; WP_n still valid.
L16: Status bit 0 (FAIL) shall report last-command outcome.
L16: R/B_n shall be open-drain; LOW when any LUN busy.

L16: Parameter Page CRC polynomial 8005h, init 4F4Eh, no final XOR, no bit reversal, MSB-first per byte.
L16: Parameter Page ≥ 3 redundant copies at offsets 0/256/512.
L16: Read ID (90h + 20h) shall return 'ONFI' signature on ONFI-compliant devices.

L16: NV-DDR3 devices shall implement Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h) and Readback (64h) mandatory.
L16: WP_n LOW shall disable Program / Erase; shall NOT disable Read.
L16: WP_n shall not transition during active Program/Erase or with Write Enable active.
L16: Reset (FFh) → SDR mode 0, volatile state cleared.
L16: Synchronous Reset (FCh) shall preserve active data interface and timing mode.
L16: Read Status Enhanced (78h) shall turn off output buffers of other LUNs.
L16: Set / Get Features shall transfer exactly 4 P-bytes per feature address.

L16: Volume Select (E1h) shall direct subsequent commands in CE_n pin reduction.
L16: Read Cache End (3Fh) shall terminate Read Cache sequences.
L16: tCCS shall be observed after second address byte of Change Read/Write Column.
L16: tADL shall be observed after second address byte of Page Program.
L16: Factory-marked bad blocks shall not be erased (FAIL bit).
